ATLASSIAN_ALLINPMPREP_AUTH.title: Atlassian MCP Authorization header (All-In PM Prep)
ATLASSIAN_ALLINPMPREP_AUTH.description: Set in Cursor Dashboard > Plugins > Configure so no device runs OAuth. Service account: 'Bearer <api_key>'. Personal token: 'Basic <base64(email:api_token)>'. Requires an Atlassian org admin to enable API-token auth for the Rovo MCP server.
